units: <cite ref="Yevamot 46b:3">Yeb. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>ודילמא נ׳ בעלמא</he> perhaps mere cleanliness of appearance is intended? (not levitical purification).

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:15">Sot. IX, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:3:5">Y. Shek. III, end, 47ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 20b:10">Ab. Zar. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>זריזות מביאה לידי נ׳</he> zeal leads to cleanliness, <he>נ׳ מביאה וכ׳</he> cleanliness leads to levitical purity.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:12:4">Y. Pes. VII, 35ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אינה אלא נ׳</he> it is a mere matter of cleanliness.
<cite ref="Temurah 3b:3">Tem. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>ואימא … נ׳ כלל</he> may I not say, it means that there is no expiation for him?; a. e.

senses.gloss: respectability, dignity. Sifra K’dosh., Par. 2, ch. IV מתפרנס בנ׳ he will make a decent living (not be dependent on charity).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99:7">Gen. R. s. 99</cite>; a. e.
